item.title: Democrats broke airport security. Now they're calling the solution dangerous
item.summary: President Trump ordered ICE officers to U.S. airports amid a TSA staffing crisis. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries warned the deployment could result in agents killing travelers.

item.title: Driver hops curb, strikes 9 students during after school pickup in Iowa
item.summary: Nine students were injured after a vehicle struck them in a pickup line after school in Ankeny, Iowa, officials said. The driver was not injured in the incident.

item.summary: 'Dalilah's Law,' backed by President Trump, passed the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee. Now it heads to a full congressional vote.

item.title: NJ Gov. Sherrill attends mosque led by Imam once accused of Hamas ties in deportation case
